warnings: Day 1: Long driving day (4h30 outbound Paris→Gerardmer + 2h30 round-trip to Grand Ballon trailhead + short in-town drives). Plan rest stop on highway at Aire de Sandaucourt (A31, near Toul). Consider arriving night before if fatigued

Day 1: Breakfast — Boulangerie Vaxelaire (07:00) is now a pre-departure stop in Paris or a service station pastry en route. The bakery in Gerardmer (45 Rue Charles de Gaulle) is a good option to swing by after arriving at 11:00 if the group wants local pastries. May 1: confirm opening hours
Day 1: May 1 Labour Day — confirm Ferme Auberge du Grand Ballon (+33 3 89 76 95 79) and Chalet Au Bord du Lac Hotel Restaurant (+33 3 29 63 01 03) are open; many shops closed on this public holiday

Day 1: Ferme Auberge du Grand Ballon is at the Grand Ballon summit on Route des Crêtes. With own car, lunch in Gerardmer (11:30-13:00) before driving to the trailhead is the practical approach. If Ferme Auberge is confirmed open, adjust schedule: skip Gerardmer lunch, drive directly at 11:30, eat at summit (~17:30-18:30)

Day 1: Grand Ballon hike finishes at 17:36. With 75-min return drive, arrival in Gerardmer is 18:51. Brief freshen-up before 19:00 dinner is tight — Chalet Au Bord du Lac is only ~5 min drive from studio so timing is feasible

Day 1: Chalet Au Bord du Lac is on Route d'Epinal at the west end of the lake — same side as studio (175A Chemin du Tour du Lac). Return to studio after dinner is only ~5-10 min drive or walkable (~15 min)

Day 2: Ferme Auberge du Frankenthal — reserve in advance (+33 6 78 52 15 11), cash preferred, confirm open Saturday May 2

Day 2: La Cave au Geromé is CLOSED on Sundays and May 1. Plan visit on Saturday May 2 after returning from trailhead (17:30 slot confirmed: open Tue-Sat)

warnings: Day 3: 5h drive back to Paris after 4h30 hike — total fatigue risk is HIGH. Consider extending trip by half-day or stopping in Strasbourg/Nancy if tired. Sunday A4 traffic near Paris can add 30-45 min
Day 3: TIMING CRITICAL — Tour des Trois Lacs (4h36) starts 07:50, finishes 12:24. Lunch at Auberge du Lac Noir (12:24-13:24). Drive departs 13:30 from Lac Blanc parking, arrives Paris ~18:30
Day 3: Auberge du Lac Noir lunch is on the trail route — reservation strongly recommended (+33 3 89 71 21 80), especially on a weekend

Day 3: Fishing at Trois Lacs (09:45-10:30) is integrated within the Tour des Trois Lacs hike — represents a fishing break at Lac Noir during the circuit. Purchase fishing permit in advance at cartedepeche.fr (~15 EUR)
Day 3: Tour des Trois Lacs and Fishing at Trois Lacs overlap by design (fishing is a break within the hike) — not a scheduling conflict
Day 3: Studio checkout by 07:00 — contact Agnès Marchal (06 86 96 16 04) if early checkout arrangement is needed. Luggage stays in car throughout the hike (car parked at Lac Blanc)

Day 3: Dinner entry (18:00-19:00) represents a meal stop during the return drive to Paris — stop at a motorway service station (e.g. Aire de Reichstett on A4 near Strasbourg) or eat upon arrival in Paris. No train-based dinner applies — self-driving
Day 3: Boutique de la Confiserie Géromoise REMOVED from Day 3 schedule — studio checkout is at 07:00 and shop does not open that early. Buy souvenirs on Day 2 evening in town center instead
